RIPPERS.Guise.IdentityHint: The persona behind the mask (e.g. Inspector Grange)
RIPPERS.Guise.RoleHint: One-line cover / how it reads on the street
RIPPERS.Guise.DropClass: Drop a class Item here to add it to this guise
RIPPERS.Guise.DropSkill: Drop a skill Item here (allocate its SL below)
RIPPERS.Guise.DropEquip: Drop a weapon / armour / accessory here
RIPPERS.Guise.FixedLockHint: This guise's classes, equipment and affinities are fixed at distillation — read-only. A GM can unlock them with the module's edit override.
RIPPERS.Guise.EditSLHint: Toggle editing skill levels — SLs rise as the character gains experience (the class roster and affinities stay fixed).
RIPPERS.Guise.SwapHint: Click this guise on the character sheet to bind it (dismissing any other). Exactly one guise is active at a time; its skills, equipment and affinities apply only while it is bound.
RIPPERS.Guise.DormancyHint: While this guise is bound, your own innate skills sleep — only the mask's allocated skills are live (one 30-level set at a time). Dismiss the guise to wake them.
RIPPERS.Benefit.ChooseUpTo2: Choose up to two — your two permanent creation benefits. (The familiar trades both.)
RIPPERS.Benefit.Contested: Contested — one character in the party may take this.
RIPPERS.Builder.Title: Guise Builder
RIPPERS.Builder.Name: Name
RIPPERS.Builder.NoSkills: No skills recorded for this class.
RIPPERS.Builder.OverrideOn: GM edit override is ON — fixed fields are editable and validation only warns.
RIPPERS.Builder.DismissFirst: Dismiss this guise before editing it — a bound guise has its skills and equipment live on the character. (A GM can bypass this with the edit override.)
RIPPERS.Builder.EditBoundWarn: Editing a bound guise via the override — dismiss and re-bind it to re-materialise its skills and equipment.
RIPPERS.Builder.PickClassFirst: Pick at least one class on the Classes step first.
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeInnate: The Innate Guise (the face under the masks)
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeWornHint: A mask distilled from a monster: three classes, equipment, an affinity trio, a Perk, a +3 Bonus, a Tell and a narrative bane.
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeInnateHint: Your base self: three innate classes, its Specialties (two, or four if Talented), a creation Heroic, the Hunter Weapon, and its own armour + accessory. No affinities, no Nature, Tell or Perk.
RIPPERS.Builder.NatureHint: the Guise's identity — the face it wears
RIPPERS.Builder.TrioHint: A guise inherits its source monster's affinities: at most one Immunity — which must be paired with a Vulnerability — and one Resistance. A guise never grants Absorption.
RIPPERS.Builder.AffInnateNone: The Innate Guise has no affinity modifiers — it keeps your own.
RIPPERS.Builder.AffNoneReview: None — this guise keeps the wearer's own affinities.
RIPPERS.Builder.EquipmentHint: Drag a weapon, shield, armour or accessory here — an attached armour, two hands, and an accessory.
RIPPERS.Builder.DropEquip: Drag an item here to attach it
RIPPERS.Builder.PerkHint: free flavour — e.g. Nightsight, Scent, Kin-Speech (answers "can you?", never "how well?")
RIPPERS.Builder.BonusHint: the circumstance the +3 applies to — e.g. "when acting to protect a child"
RIPPERS.Builder.BonusNote: A narrative scope, not a mechanical check type — the GM applies the +3 when a check fits.
RIPPERS.Builder.BaneHint: the material that harms the source monster (silver, cold iron, running water…)
RIPPERS.Builder.SpecialtiesHint: Type exactly two — pick a suggestion or write your own. In an in-subject Check, improve one die's size.
RIPPERS.Builder.Talented: Talented keystone — four Specialties instead of two
RIPPERS.Builder.InnateHeroicHint: One Heroic Skill, attached to the Innate Guise (it sleeps while you wear a mask). Banned-at-creation heroics are refused.
RIPPERS.Builder.HunterWeaponHint: Belongs to the character, not the Guise. Drag a weapon here; it carries the Innate Guise instead of armour and hands.
RIPPERS.Builder.InnateEquipmentHint: The Innate Guise's own armour and accessory — the character's kit while unmasked. Equipped on the actor; a worn mask's own gear displaces them and is restored when you take it off.
RIPPERS.Builder.SignatureHeroicHint: Every worn Guise carries one Heroic Skill of its own — distinct from your character's. It switches on while the Guise is worn and off when you take it off.
RIPPERS.Builder.AttachedEffectsHint: Effects that travel with this Guise (e.g. Greater Akromorphosis) — drag any effect-bearing Item here. It switches on automatically when the Guise is worn and off when it's stashed. Attach body/standing effects (mutations, granted abilities), not knowledge or goods.
RIPPERS.Settings.EditOverride: GM edit override (unlock fixed guise fields)
RIPPERS.Settings.EditOverrideHint: When on, a GM may edit a guise's normally-fixed fields (its three classes, equipment and affinity trio) on the sheet and in the builder, and guise validation only warns instead of blocking. Leave off for normal play — a guise is fixed at distillation.
RIPPERS.Specialty.PickAttr: Which attribute's die does the Specialty improve on your next Check?
RIPPERS.Specialty.Armed: Specialty armed: your next Open/skill Check improves one die (not Magic or Accuracy).
RIPPERS.Specialty.NotHere: A Specialty does not improve Magic or Accuracy Checks — die-bump not applied (still armed).
RIPPERS.Clot.OverSockets: "{name}" has {capacity} Clot socket(s) at this level; that loadout needs {needed}.
RIPPERS.Clot.OverImmunity: A character may carry at most two Clot-granted Immunities across all weapons and armor; this loadout would make {total}.
RIPPERS.Clot.SlotHost: Slot a Clot onto a custom weapon or armor.
RIPPERS.Sheet.Title: Rippers Character Sheet
RIPPERS.Sheet.Label: Rippers Sheet
RIPPERS.Sheet.ReadOnlyNote: Rippers sheet — Phase 1 (read-only). Controls arrive in Phase 2.
RIPPERS.Sheet.SwapHint: Swap or unmask the worn guise
RIPPERS.Sheet.NoTarget: No target selected — target a token first.
RIPPERS.Sheet.BoundLockNote: bound — structural fields locked while worn
RIPPERS.Sheet.FixedList: Classes · equipment · affinity trio are locked; the GM override unlocks them
RIPPERS.Sheet.SLToggleNote: Skill levels edit behind the builder's Edit SL toggle (players).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondCleansePrompt: Which status does the bond cleanse?
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondDieRaised: Attribute die raised for the scene.
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondSkillPrompt: Name the granted skill (apply it manually).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondSkillRefused: Only an eternal bond grants a skill (GM only).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondSolidifyRestPrompt: Choose fleeting bonds to solidify — the rest are erased.
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondClockEmotion: Clock filled — the player adds one emotion (their choice of axis).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondSolidifyRefused: Cannot solidify (cap reached, not fleeting, or GM only).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondEternalRefused: Cannot promote to eternal (not solid, or GM only).
RIPPERS.Sheet.BondClockRefused: Only solid bonds carry a clock (GM only).
